usage: llm-modelbench runtime-fit [-h] --model MODEL
                                  [--runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE]
                                  [--context CONTEXT]
                                  [--reserve-mib RESERVE_MIB]
                                  [--strategy {layer_split,tensor_split}]
                                  [--allocation-weights ALLOCATION_WEIGHTS]
                                  [--allow-cpu-spill] [--json] [--out OUT]
                                  [--mock]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         exact model name already known to the selected runtime
  --runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE
                        saved runtime profile; explicit selection takes
                        precedence
  --context CONTEXT     requested context; never silently clamped
  --reserve-mib RESERVE_MIB
                        per-device safety reserve in MiB
  --strategy {layer_split,tensor_split}
                        explicit multi-GPU strategy declaration
  --allocation-weights ALLOCATION_WEIGHTS
                        comma-separated GPU-UUID=weight layer allocations;
                        never positional
  --allow-cpu-spill     advisory only: mark spill operator-permitted for this
                        estimate. Host RAM capacity is not checked here;
                        actual RAM-spill feasibility is decided by the
                        benchmark execution preflight
  --json                write deterministic JSON to stdout
  --out OUT             optional JSON output path
  --mock                use the offline deterministic model client
